author: harness:codex

patch.value: Give arbitrary files stable identities and native PM-linked change attribution

Add stable FileId values to tree entries so moves preserve logical identity, copies mint new identities with provenance, and pm-vcs can resolve PM-linked text or binary files through native ChangeIds and commits without Git or a mutable attribution database.

Move preserves FileId while copy mints a new FileId with an auditable source edge; pm vcs items files changes and trace answer PM attribution from immutable commits plus PM history; pm vcs commit --item validates the PM item and records an explicit association without editing the item; Two-agent branch merges retain attribution for different linked files and deleted files remain historically traceable; Sparse or incomplete history reports required missing fragments instead of an incomplete answer

value.note: Stable file identity and PM attribution contract
